_comment: Solo stratum for ASICs. Every miner gets its own coinbase: 98% to the address it authorises with, 2% to solo_fee_address. Nothing is credited to the TIDES window and nothing is owed after the block - the payout is the block. prime_port 0 keeps this instance standalone, so it cannot disturb the pooled gateways or Prime.
_vardiff_comment: Floor 8192 so a ~1 TH/s box cannot walk down to 1024. Start at the floor; vardiff still climbs 4x per eight shares to the 131072 cap for higher-hashrate ASICs. Share difficulty does not affect a solo payout, only the share rate and the hashrate readout.
